content: {"like":["Enjoys over‑the‑top action with satisfying villain payback (e.g., John Wick).","Prefers films that blend classic sci‑fi with atmospheric isolation (e.g., Alien).","Values creative plot devices that tie in familiar elements (e.g., Battleship’s board‑game integration).","Appreciates modern sports‑themed underdog stories with humor (e.g., Here Comes the Boom).","Likes well‑cast, tightly plotted sci‑fi with clever twists (e.g., The Martian)."],"dislike":["Dislikes movies with simplistic, stereotypical characterizations (e.g., Avatar).","Avoids films with unrealistic or graphic violence that feels staged (e.g., Here Comes the Boom).","Rejects long, boring rescue sequences and poor editing (e.g., The Martian).","Finds lack of humor in interviews or stand‑up disappointing (e.g., unspecified).","Dislikes meandering plots where storylines never converge (e.g., unspecified)."]}
